problem: A3 selectively abstains; conditioning only on emitted outputs can make repair burden look artificially low.

COMMON_EMISSION_REPAIR.population: Frozen P49 items on which both A1 and A3 emit a surface.
COMMON_EMISSION_REPAIR.object: Paired R0 repair vector under the same owner/task.
COMMON_EMISSION_REPAIR.identifies: Repairability difference among emitted outputs only.
COMMON_EMISSION_REPAIR.does_not_identify: End-to-end workflow burden when A3 abstains.

SYSTEM_WORKFLOW_BURDEN.population: All frozen P49 source tasks including A3 abstentions.
SYSTEM_WORKFLOW_BURDEN.object: Generation/abstention plus any human fallback completion/repair needed to finish the task.

rules: Never impute zero repair burden to A3 abstention.
Never drop abstentions from coverage reporting.
A common-emission repair gain may be promoted as EMITTED_OUTPUT_OWNER_LOCAL only if preservation is non-worse.
A full system/workflow improvement claim requires either zero A3 abstention on the frozen packet or prospectively observed fallback-completion traces for abstained items.
Fallback completion is a separate action lane, not silently converted into ordinary REPAIR.
No arbitrary scalar abstention penalty is introduced.
